title: Curtis LeMay gave D. Harold Byrd a Civil Air Patrol award

tellings.quote: Curtis Lame gave him an award for the Civil Airore when he was younger.

plain: Curtis LeMay, a top US Air Force general, once gave a Texas businessman named D. Harold Byrd an award for his work with the Civil Air Patrol, a volunteer civilian branch attached to the Air Force, when Byrd was younger. Jesse Michels brings this up himself, without naming a source, in a 2025 episode about President John F. Kennedy with a lawyer named Danny Sheehan. He offers it as a sign that Byrd had close ties to military power.
